thesisQuality.basis: Record quarterly revenue, broadening backlog and multi-segment demand plus new AI-power/autonomy use cases support exceptional-band durability, conservatively near the lower bound because AI economics remain partly unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue +24%, operating margin expanded to 20.9%, operating cash flow $4.4B, $6.7B cash and growing backlog support exceptional operating/funding momentum.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: September trailing P/E about 39.6x versus 30.3x at end-2025 is demanding despite strong growth, supporting the weak 21-40 valuation band rather than silently assuming upside.

catalystScore.basis: 2-GW deliveries beginning September 2026 plus current physical-AI collaboration provide multiple source-supported near/medium catalysts; undisclosed economics cap the value near the bottom of exceptional.

governancePower.basis: Strong operating execution, $2.2B quarterly shareholder returns, 8% dividend increase and 32 consecutive years of higher annual dividends support strong stewardship; this does not claim exceptional governance absent fuller proxy evidence.

alignment2036.basis: Power generation, construction/mining infrastructure and physical-AI/autonomy capabilities serve durable infrastructure, energy and productivity needs across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Broadening momentum across Power & Energy, Construction Industries and Resource Industries plus reusable digital/autonomy capabilities supports multiple independent demand engines.

bottleneckControl.basis: A 2-GW dedicated-power order and large dealer/equipment platform show scarce deployable power/industrial capability, while alternatives prevent a no-substitute claim.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Three major industrial segments, financing, power and automation exposure diversify outcomes across infrastructure/resource/AI scenarios, though industrial cyclicality remains.

substitutionResilience.basis: Large installed/dealer ecosystem and integration of AI/autonomy into heavy equipment support strong replacement barriers/adaptability, but alternative equipment and power architectures remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong current execution and cash capacity support resilience, but retrieved evidence does not establish exceptional tested supplier redundancy; score remains inside strong band below 80.

pricingPower.basis: $595M favorable price realization alongside operating-margin expansion to 20.9% is direct observed evidence of strong price capture.

riskEvidence.basis: Premium valuation, industrial cyclicality, execution/commissioning uncertainty and gas-power fuel/permitting/emissions exposure are material but balanced by strong cash generation and backlog.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary operating evidence and multiple distinct issuer origins cover most components, with independent current valuation evidence; confidence is reduced for undisclosed order economics, supply-chain detail and limited independent corroboration.

scoreRecord.thesis: Caterpillar combines broad industrial demand, strong current operating momentum, power-generation capacity and emerging physical-AI leverage, but current valuation embeds substantial success.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: A premium valuation and cyclical end markets amplify downside if backlog conversion, AI-power commissioning or margins disappoint.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Execution of the 2-GW AI-infrastructure generator delivery window beginning September 2026 and subsequent evidence of realized economics.
